title: tier-2 shipped code: the MRNM runtime-block size against MrnmRuntimeSize (0x141b89390)
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-tank/src/mrnm.rs (runtime_size), built by cargo and called by crates/ow-tank/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the mrnm_runtime_size entry.

Oracle is MrnmRuntimeSize at exe 0x141b89390 (v2b 0x7ff7c68a9390), 0x2F bytes. It returns submesh_count*0xa0 + 0xc0 + vertex_count*0xf8 + index_count*0x18 as a 32-bit int; the probe returns the same value zero-extended.
Three reads: u32 at payload+0x1c (submeshes), u8 at +0x22 (vertex buffers), u8 at +0x23 (index buffers). The fixture varies all three over their full descriptor counts, including the all-zero case.
The function is straight-line, so coverage is 100% by construction. Every constant in the formula is mutation-killable: each count is exercised at a value above 0.
acknowledgedGaps: The client's arithmetic is a 32-bit int expression. The fixture never produces counts large enough to overflow (the descriptors cap at 3), so the wrapping behaviour is documented in the port but not exercised.
